verses.original: ה֚וֹי הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֣ים בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְהַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בְּהַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן נְקֻבֵי֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֥אוּ לָהֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w haš·ša·’ă·nan·nîm bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm bə·har šō·mə·rō·wn nə·qu·ḇê rê·šîṯ hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇā·’ū lā·hem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Woe to those at ease in Zion and those secure on Mount Samaria the distinguished ones of the foremost nation to whom the house of Israel comes
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que vivem sossegados em Sião e dos que estão seguros no monte de Samaria, dos homens notáveis da principal das nações, aos quais vêm a casa de Israel!

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ כַֽלְנֵה֙ וּרְא֔וּ וּלְכ֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם חֲמַ֣ת רַבָּ֑ה וּרְד֣וּ גַת־ פְּלִשְׁתּ֗ים הֲטוֹבִים֙ מִן־ הַמַּמְלָכ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה אִם־ רַ֥ב גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִגְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iḇ·rū ḵal·nêh ū·rə·’ū ū·lə·ḵū miš·šām ḥă·maṯ rab·bāh ū·rə·ḏū ḡaṯ- pə·liš·tm hă·ṭō·w·ḇîm min- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ’im- raḇ gə·ḇū·lām mig·gə·ḇul·ḵem
verses.literal: Cross over to Calneh and see go from there to the great Hamath then go down to Gath of the Philistines Are you better than these . . . kingdoms Is their territory larger than yours
verses.literalPt: Passai a Calné e vede; dali, ide à grande Hamate; então, descei a Gate dos filisteus; são, porventura, melhores do que estes reinos? Ou são os seus termos maiores do que os vossos termos?

verses.original: הַֽמְנַדִּ֖ים לְי֣וֹם רָ֑ע וַתַּגִּישׁ֖וּן שֶׁ֥בֶת חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ham·nad·dîm lə·yō·wm rā‘ wat·tag·gî·šūn še·ḇeṯ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós que afastais o dia mau e fazeis que se aproxime o assento da violência!

verses.original: הַשֹּֽׁכְבִים֙ עַל־ מִטּ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔ן וּסְרֻחִ֖ים עַל־ עַרְשׂוֹתָ֑ם וְאֹכְלִ֤ים כָּרִים֙ מִצֹּ֔אן וַעֲגָלִ֖ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ מַרְבֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘al- miṭ·ṭō·wṯ šên ū·sə·ru·ḥîm ‘al- ‘ar·śō·w·ṯām wə·’ō·ḵə·lîm kā·rîm miṣ·ṣōn wa·‘ă·ḡā·lîm mit·tō·wḵ mar·bêq
verses.literal: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory and lounge upon your couches You dine on lambs from the flock and calves from the stall
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que dormem em camas de marfim, e se estendem sobre os seus leitos, e comem os cordeiros tirados do rebanho e os bezerros do meio da estrebaria;

verses.original: הַפֹּרְטִ֖ים עַל־ פִּ֣י הַנָּ֑בֶל כְּדָוִ֕יד חָשְׁב֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם כְּלֵי־ שִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pō·rə·ṭîm ‘al- pî han·nā·ḇel kə·ḏā·wîḏ ḥā·šə·ḇū lā·hem kə·lê- šîr
verses.literal: You improvise songs on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments
verses.literalPt: que garganteiam ao som da lira; que inventam para si instrumentos de música, assim como Davi;

verses.original: הַשֹּׁתִ֤ים בְּמִזְרְקֵי֙ יַ֔יִן וְרֵאשִׁ֥ית שְׁמָנִ֖ים יִמְשָׁ֑חוּ וְלֹ֥א נֶחְל֖וּ עַל־ שֵׁ֥בֶר יוֹסֵֽף
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·ṯîm bə·miz·rə·qê ya·yin wə·rê·šîṯ šə·mā·nîm yim·šā·ḥū wə·lō neḥ·lū ‘al- šê·ḇer yō·sēp̄
verses.literal: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph
verses.literalPt: que bebem vinho de bacias e se ungem com óleo mais precioso; porém não se afligem pela quebra de José.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן עַתָּ֥ה יִגְל֖וּ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ גֹּלִ֑ים וְסָ֖ר מִרְזַ֥ח סְרוּחִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘at·tāh yiḡ·lū bə·rōš gō·lîm wə·sār mir·zaḥ sə·rū·ḥîm
verses.literal: Therefore you will now go into exile as the first of the captives and your feasting and lounging will come to an end
verses.literalPt: Portanto, pois, irão cativos entre os primeiros que forem levados cativos, e cessará a galhofa dos que banqueteiam.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּע֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת מְתָאֵ֤ב אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְאַרְמְנֹתָ֖יו שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְהִסְגַּרְתִּ֖י עִ֥יר וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: niš·ba‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·nap̄·šōw nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mə·ṯā·’êḇ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eṯ- gə·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·’ar·mə·nō·ṯāw śā·nê·ṯî wə·his·gar·tî ‘îr ū·mə·lō·’āh
verses.literal: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself the LORD the God of Hosts has declared I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels so I will deliver up the city and everything in it
verses.literalPt: Jurou o Senhor Jeová por si mesmo, diz Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos: Eu abomino a soberba de Jacó e aborreço os seus palácios; por isso, entregarei a cidade e tudo que nela houver.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ יִוָּ֨תְר֜וּ עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים בְּבַ֥יִת אֶחָ֖ד וָמֵֽתוּ׃
verses.literal: And if there are ten men left in one house they too will die
verses.literalPt: Se numa casa ficarem dez homens, morrerão eles.

verses.original: וּנְשָׂא֞וֹ דּוֹד֣וֹ וּמְסָרְפ֗וֹ לְהוֹצִ֣יא עֲצָמִים֮ מִן־ הַבַּיִת֒ וְאָמַ֞ר לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת הַע֥וֹד עִמָּ֖ךְ וְאָמַ֣ר אָ֑פֶס וְאָמַ֣ר הָ֔ס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לְהַזְכִּ֖יר בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śā·’ōw dō·w·ḏōw ū·mə·sā·rə·p̄ōw lə·hō·w·ṣî ‘ă·ṣā·mîm min- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·’ā·mar la·’ă·šer bə·yar·kə·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ ha·‘ō·wḏ ‘im·māḵ wə·’ā·mar ’ā·p̄es wə·’ā·mar hās kî lō lə·haz·kîr bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: And when the relative who is to burn the bodies picks them up . . . to remove them from the house he will call to one inside Is anyone else with you None that person will answer Silence the relative will retort for the name of the LORD must not be invoked
verses.literalPt: Quando o parente dum homem, isto é, aquele que o queima, o tomar para lhe levar da casa os ossos e disser ao que estiver no mais interior da casa: Acaso, está ainda alguém contigo? E este responder: Não; então, lhe dirá ele: Cala-te; não se pode mencionar o nome de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וְהִכָּ֛ה הַבַּ֥יִת הַגָּד֖וֹל רְסִיסִ֑ים וְהַבַּ֥יִת הַקָּטֹ֖ן בְּקִעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh Yah·weh mə·ṣaw·weh wə·hik·kāh hab·ba·yiṯ hag·gā·ḏō·wl rə·sî·sîm wə·hab·ba·yiṯ haq·qā·ṭōn bə·qi·‘îm
verses.literal: For . . . the LORD gives a command The great house will be smashed to pieces and the small house to rubble
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que Jeová ordena, e a casa grande há de ser ferida de brechas, e a casa pequena, de fendas.

verses.original: הַיְרֻצ֤וּן בַּסֶּ֙לַע֙ סוּסִ֔ים אִֽם־ יַחֲר֖וֹשׁ בַּבְּקָרִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הֲפַכְתֶּ֤ם לְרֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּפְרִ֥י צְדָקָ֖ה לְלַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hay·ru·ṣūn bas·se·la‘ sū·sîm ’im- ya·ḥă·rō·wōš bab·bə·qā·rîm kî- hă·p̄aḵ·tem lə·rōš miš·pāṭ ū·p̄ə·rî ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·la·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Do horses . . . gallop on the cliffs Does one plow the sea with oxen But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood
verses.literalPt: Acaso, correrão cavalos pelo penhasco? Lavrar-se-á ali com bois? Visto que tendes convertido em fel o juízo e em absinto, o fruto da justiça,

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֖ים לְלֹ֣א דָבָ֑ר הָאֹ֣מְרִ֔ים הֲל֣וֹא בְחָזְקֵ֔נוּ לָקַ֥חְנוּ לָ֖נוּ קַרְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śə·mê·ḥîm lə·lō ḏā·ḇār hā·’ō·mə·rîm hă·lō·w ḇə·ḥā·zə·qê·nū lā·qaḥ·nū lā·nū qar·nā·yim
verses.literal: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength
verses.literalPt: vós que vos alegrais do nada, que dizeis: Não é assim que por nossa própria força nos temos tornado poderosos?

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנְנִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת גּ֑וֹי וְלָחֲצ֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־ נַ֥חַל הָעֲרָבָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî mê·qîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ gō·w wə·lā·ḥă·ṣū ’eṯ·ḵem mil·lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ ‘aḏ- na·ḥal hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: For behold I will raise up a nation against you O house of Israel declares the LORD the God of Hosts and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath . . . to the Brook of the Arabah
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que, diz Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, levantarei contra vós, ó casa de Israel, uma nação, e vos oprimirão desde a entrada de Hamate até a torrente da Arabá.
